actions.create_contact_attribute_key.des: Adds a custom contact attribute, such as plan or company.
actions.create_contact_attribute_key.pro: Letters, numbers and underscores, for example company_size.
Creates a custom contact attribute key in a workspace ID.
actions.create_response.description: Adds a response to a survey, for example to import answers collected elsewhere.
Link the response to this contact. Optional.
actions.create_response.props.data.descr: Answers keyed by question ID. Run Get Survey to see the question IDs.
actions.create_response_ai.description: Creates a Formbricks response for a survey ID.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_contact.description: Permanently deletes a contact and its attributes.
actions.delete_contact.props.contactId.d: Use Find Contact to get the ID from an email.
actions.find_contact.description: Finds a contact by email or user ID.
actions.find_contact.props.email.descrip: Fill in the email or the user ID.
actions.find_contact_ai.description: Finds a Formbricks contact by email or user ID in a workspace ID.
actions.get_contact_survey_link.descript: Generates a survey link tied to one contact, so the response is linked to them.
actions.get_contact_survey_link.props.co: Use Find Contact to get the ID from an email.
actions.get_contact_survey_link.props.ex: 1 to 365. Leave empty for a link that never expires.
actions.get_contact_survey_link_ai.descr: Generates a personal survey link for a survey ID and contact ID.
actions.get_response.description: Gets a single survey response by its ID.
actions.get_response.props.responseId.de: From a Formbricks trigger or List Responses.
actions.get_survey.description: Gets a survey with its questions and their IDs.
actions.get_survey_ai.description: Gets a Formbricks survey by ID.
actions.list_action_classes.description: Lists the user actions (action classes) that can trigger in-app surveys.
actions.list_action_classes.props.worksp: Only actions of this workspace. Leave empty for all.
actions.list_contact_attribute_keys.desc: Lists the contact attributes (email, user ID and custom ones) defined in Formbricks.
actions.list_contact_attribute_keys.prop: Only keys of this workspace. Leave empty for all.
actions.list_responses.description: Lists survey responses, newest first, with optional survey and date filters.
actions.list_responses.props.endDate.des: Only responses created on or before this date.
actions.list_responses.props.skip.descri: Number of responses to skip, for paging.
actions.list_responses.props.startDate.d: Only responses created on or after this date.
actions.list_responses.props.surveyId.de: Only list responses to this survey. Leave empty for all surveys.
actions.list_responses_ai.description: Lists Formbricks responses filtered by survey, contact and date.
actions.list_responses_ai.props.dateFiel: Field the date range and sort order use. Default createdAt.
actions.list_surveys.description: Lists the surveys in a workspace, optionally only those with a given status. Scans up to 1,000 surveys; "More Available" is true when the list may be incomplete.
actions.list_surveys.props.limit.descrip: Maximum number of surveys to return (1 to 500).
actions.list_surveys.props.status.descri: Only list surveys with this status.
actions.list_surveys.props.workspaceId.d: Only list surveys from this workspace. Leave empty for every workspace the API key can access.
actions.list_surveys_ai.description: Lists Formbricks surveys by workspace ID and status.
actions.list_surveys_ai.props.limit.desc: Maximum number of surveys to return (1 to 500, default 100).
actions.list_surveys_ai.props.workspaceI: Only surveys from this workspace. Empty for all workspaces.
actions.update_response.description: Changes answers on a response or marks it finished.
actions.update_response.props.data.descr: Answers keyed by question ID. Leave empty to keep them.
actions.update_response.props.finished.d: Leave empty to keep the current value.
actions.update_survey_status.description: Pauses, resumes or completes a survey.
actions.update_survey_status_ai.descript: Sets a Formbricks survey status by survey ID.
actions.upsert_contact.description: Creates a contact, or updates the contact with the same email.
Extra attributes as key and value. New keys are created.
actions.upsert_contact.props.userId.desc: Your own ID for this person. Optional.
actions.upsert_contact_ai.description: Upserts a Formbricks contact by email in a workspace ID.
actions.upsert_contact_ai.props.attribut: Object of attribute key to string value.
auth.description:
**Create an API key:**
1. Log in to Formbricks.
2. Open **Organization Settings > API Keys**.
3. Click **Add API Key**, give it a label and grant **read & write** access to each workspace you want to automate.
4. Copy the key and paste it below.

**App URL:**
- Formbricks Cloud: `https://app.formbricks.com`
- Self-hosted: the address you open Formbricks at, for example `https://surveys.example.com`. A trailing slash or `/api` is removed automatically.
triggers.formbricks_trigger_response_cre: Triggers when someone starts answering a survey (a new response is created).
Only responses to these surveys start the flow. Leave empty to react to every survey in the workspace.
The Formbricks workspace whose survey responses start this flow.
triggers.formbricks_trigger_response_fin: Triggers when a respondent completes a survey.
Only responses to these surveys start the flow. Leave empty to react to every survey in the workspace.
The Formbricks workspace whose survey responses start this flow.
triggers.formbricks_trigger_response_upd: Triggers when an existing response gets new or changed answers.
Only responses to these surveys start the flow. Leave empty to react to every survey in the workspace.
The Formbricks workspace whose survey responses start this flow.
